Results.ReviewText: After several other brands that were cheaper, fell apart after a year  and cooked unevenly, we got this Weber. Best decision, ever. Sturdy, well-built and cooks like a dream. The only problem we had was that we were used to just cranking on the gas; this has a safety feature and when you do that, the grill doesn't heat above around 325. I read the brochure for troubleshooting, now know to turn the gas on slowly, and it has worked like a dream. I am hoping I never have to use the warranty, but it's comforting to know that if I have any problems for the next 10 years, it should be taken care of. iGrill3 makes it easy! Easily worth the investment.
Family is fed and happy. I have now earned my man-card back!

Results.ReviewText: I am embarrassed to say that I gave up my man-card long ago, because I lack the male natural instinct of grilling. Well, I decided to re-engage and go all-in! I did my research, read reviews, etc. If I am going to invest in a grill, I wanted one that will last a long time and that's well-built. I decided on this model for it's middle-of-the-road slot. I wanted a Weber for their amazing reputation, quality, and warranty. I could have gotten a $200 special, and probably be fine, but I didn't want to buy a grill and have it be flimsy and rust out after a year. I picked up this one at my local HD, and I opted to put it together myself so I could get to know every square inch of the thing. Taking my time, it took about 2 hours to assemble it. It wasn't that bad, the instructions were easy. Everything fit together seamlessly! You can REALLY see the material quality this way. Everything has a high quality finish. Even the screws are coated to prevent rust. I also added the igrill3 to help me with my "man card" issue so there is no guessing on food temperatures. I put it together by 1pm Sunday, did the 20 minute "burn off" and prepared chicken and shrimp for my family. The grill got up to temp faster than I expected. I keep reading that these grills are designed to work best with the hood down, so I followed that order. Everything came out perfect! (well, almost perfect, the chicken could have used juuuust a little more seasoning) Temperature was easy to control. Do yourself a favor, and get the igrill3! And don't forget the regular Weber app, lots of good info on there. I doubt other cheaper manufacturers have this much support and information that Weber does. Kudos to Weber for making such a high quality product and amazing support and information! My only issue is that I will now get addicted to grilling, and will wind up buying a bigger Weber! THANK YOU WEBER!!
Results.Title: I am embarrassed to say that I gave up my man-card

Results.ReviewText: I’ve done a good bit of grilling in the first weeks I’ve had the spirit grill. I’ve been using a Smokey Joe and not great with cooking with gas yet. I want to get the igrill option to help with getting the food done but not over cooked. I’m enjoying the grill and hope it becomes a 5 star purchase for me.
Results.Title: Hoping to enjoy this more

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Over a month in and the Spirit E310 is the best grill under $500 I have owned. Heats up quick to 700 degrees plus. Only tight on space when doing three racks of ribs by indirect heat. No flare up so far. Nice grate, no sticking, exceptional at temp. consistency.

Results.Title: Taste the meat not the heat

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: After reading the reviews and hearing about the warranty, I decided to purchase the Spirit II E-310. The grill I purchased seems constructed from quality materials, but it has the most uneven heating I've ever seen. It's terribly frustrating. The left front portion just doesn't seem to work. I don't know what the deal is. I had an expert come in and install it. I've been grilling for over 10 years. I've used all sorts of grills. I paid more money to get a Weber because of the warranty and the supposed quality of the product. I definitely regret the purchase, and I wouldn't recommend it to my friends. I dexpected more from a Weber grill.
Results.Title: Very Uneven Heating

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Love this grill! Our last Weber lasted over 25 years, and it was time for a new one. So easy to light. And wow, does it get HOT fast! Consistent heating no matter where I place my food. In the summer I grill our dinner about 90% of the time, and during the winter at least 50%, so we really use our grill. Weber quality for sure!

Results.Title: Features

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I recently bought a new Spirit which replaced a 20 year old Genesis which had been great. This new one did not disappoint and I have enjoyed it thoroughly. A very straightforward grill which is consistent in heating and easy to use and clean at a reasonable price. I would recommend it to anyone who enjoys grilling which I do—year round.
Results.Title: The best for the money

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Replaced my 15 year old Genesis Silver B with this grill. Took about 90 minutes to assemble and was pretty easy to do so. Used it a handful of times so far and can say I like the different cooking grates that are used. Spacing is a little closer together meaning less things are falling through the grates. Hope I have many years of enjoyment out of this grill like I had with my previous grill.
Results.Title: Happy so far...

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill
Results.ReviewText: Back in the beginning of the 2000's I had pretty much what any 20 something young man could ever want. A brand new home on 20 acres, wife, newborn son and a very well paying job. Well it only needed one thing and to me seemed like success was a Weber Genesis Silver C. It was burgandy and great jewel on my new deck. Thats back when people actually had cookouts every single beautiful weekend. In any event I loved that grill. That grill would bottom the thermometer out (even absolutely filty) It would cook a steak perfect at 2 minutes a side. But unfortunately about 10 years later and very minimal maintinence I lost it to divorce. She didnt take it, I left it and regret it to this day. Gone forever. I was moving to a smaller apartment and never seen the need for it at that time again... Stick with me there is a point. Well several years and a couple moves later I decided to get a Weber Smokey Joe as I missed  grilling. Then I thought how about a WebberQ. Love them both but now I need a real grill again. Kids grow, babies come family gathers. I needed a jewl for my deck a place for memories of the past for the future. I really didnt need and could well afford a new Genesis and the Spirit 2 caught my eye. I absouletly love this grill. Heats up to about 575-600 in about 15 minutes. Char marks, heat contol and Weber grill quality that I expected even for a "lower end" "starter" grill. My experience was not without its flaws, I purched from a big box store and had shipped to the house. Arrived damaged (as stated in many revies) BUT Weber did everything in their power to rush the parts out. I assembled when the new parts arived and fit together perfectly. Fired right up and has been flawless ever since. I purchased the Ivory and do not regret it. Sure if you have owned a grill before you know what to expect with cleaning a white grill and it cleans up nice. I would just like to thank Weber and Jeanette @ customer service for the grat job to get it up and running. In closing I would like to say sure its not like my Weber from 2000 but its not 2000 anymore.
Results.Title: The Weber I Remember

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grill is one of the best i had in my 40 years of grilling
